race.description: Walsco Electrical And Data Mdn Plate
race.comment: PRESTIGE PRINCE (4) was an eye-catcher on debut before spelling. Was a nice trialler in readiness to this prep but raced wide throughout at Grafton and tired in the lane. Better draw this time should see him get a more economical run and have more to offer when they quicken. HELLFIRE HENRY (2) showed positive signs in his debut prep and trialled well in readiness to this campaign but went amiss at Hawkesbury. Willing to have another look with that run out of the way. ENTIRELY OAK (1) finds the maiden win elusive but has runs sprinkled through his form that would be competitive here. DON'T BACK DOWN (5) has her first start for the Vella camp and gets a key booking in Heywood, who will need to be on top of his game from out there. Debutant FLYING MAURICE (12) is worth a market watch from the inside pillar.
